title: Unit Event — Find the Dream View — Episode6 As Professionals

meta.Event Outline: With their successes performing for a commercial and at Jam Fest, Shiho and the rest of Leo/need are feeling their growth as pro musicians. Then, they get an offer to open for a super popular group's concert.

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(“Who's Leo/need?”
“Why are these newbies the opening act?”)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(“Their agency must've shoved them in where no one wants them.”
“Can't you guys get a better band?”)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: These comments...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The opening acts for Free Cluster are usually bands like them, ones that have proven skills and staying power.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
While we're still just getting on our feet.
It only makes sense that some people would be disappointed to see us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It makes sense people will feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm starting to feel a little scared...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...
Up until this point, we've played in front of plenty of people who didn't know who we were...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we've never really played in front of those who hold negative opinions about us from the start.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This isn't completely unexpected.
But still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's tough to read these kinds of comments...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And it's perfectly normal for the others to feel scared.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (That being said...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's true, we're just finding our feet, and we still need a lot of work. Our name recognition, experience, and even our skills are still lacking...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure we've all come to realize that recently.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But even so... All we can do is do it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Because we're pros now.
It's our duty to entertain our guests by playing compelling music for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of them. No ifs, ands or buts.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't do anything about our skills and inexperience right now... But we are ready to do what we have to as professional musicians.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We've gotta go out there, put on a good performance, get everyone excited and set the perfect stage for Ms. Naruse and her band.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree with Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too. Sorry for acting all scared a second ago...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I'm fine now!
Let's keep practicing lots and lots to make sure everyone who comes has a really fun time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...! We just need to do everything in our power to put on the best show we can for them!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: (I was a little worried since it hasn't been long since they made their debut...)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: (But I guess those worries were misplaced.)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: You all sound very motivated.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Ms. Naruse...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did you hear all that?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Sorry, I actually got back a little while ago. I kept missing my chance to say something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Anyway, shall we resume?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: I want to see Leo/need put on a performance that puts any naysayers to rest!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ms. Naruse has faith in us.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We don't have much time left until the show. But we have to find a way to move the audience's hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We need to put on the perfect polish and fulfill our duty... As professionals.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We will...!)
The day of the show
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! More and more people are coming in...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. This monitor doesn't show all of the seats, but it looks like about half of the arena's already been filled.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't really grasp the scale when we were rehearsing, so seeing all these people... It's pretty overwhelming.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And we're going to play in front of all of them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho, you're nervous?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, yeah.
This is our first time playing such a big venue.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, let's do a chant that helps us relax! Oh, or would you rather we had a big group hug?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Chant aside, a group hug just sounds like something that you wanna do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Because hugs are so comforting♪
Here, my arms are wide open...

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Naruse!
How can we help you?

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: It's almost showtime, so I thought I'd stop in to give you a slap on the back.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Remember, you're the first ones our audience is going to hear. We're counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise to do our best.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Don't worry. You've done everything you can, so all that's left is for you to go all out.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: I've given you advice, but you already had what it takes to really wow an audience from the start.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: That strong will to move their hearts with your music.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: Go give them everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: And hey, it's not often that you get to play at a big venue like this, so don't forget to have lots of fun while you're out there.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Just imagine it.
From the front row to the top of the third deck, over ten thousand people will be going wild as you play for them.

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line: And you get to see that from the stage. How cool is that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Everyone going wild as we play for them...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm having trouble imagining that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But if that does actually happen, then...)

rows.Speaker: Naruse
rows.Line:
Anyway, break a leg.
I'm really looking forward to your performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
We really appreciate it!
<Girls!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku! Everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We came to show you our support, but I guess we're a little late.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Not at all.
I think we all feel a little better after seeing your faces.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Really?! Hehe. Thank goodness♪
Good luck, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! We'll leave our phones just off-stage, so feel free to watch us! We promise to put on an amazing show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We can't wait.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Go knock their socks off!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, wanna do our usual thing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our usual thing... Oh, you mean our star pieces?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I think we'll all feel better if we stick to our normal routine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
How about you lead this time, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you were pretty instrumental in getting us to this point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. I'd also like for you to lead, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See? Even our leader is saying that you should!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go out there, give it everything we have and move the hearts of everyone out there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And while we make them go wild, we're gonna have a ton of fun too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Honami, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!
